title: Disneyland Paris: Disney Adventure World and World of Frozen
description: What’s new at Disneyland Paris: Walt Disney Studios Park renamed Disney Adventure World and World of Frozen opened in March 2026. Family tips and ways to save.
h1: What’s new at Disneyland Paris: Disney Adventure World and World of Frozen
intro: Disneyland Paris’s second park has a new name and a whole new land. Here’s what changed in 2026, and how to plan a great-value family trip.

image.alt: Sleeping Beauty Castle at Disneyland Paris

cardText: The renamed second park, World of Frozen and how to plan a great-value trip.

blocks.title: Scout’s Paris plan
blocks.text: Do at least two days so you can enjoy both parks. Head to World of Frozen early, before the queues build, and keep a Disneyland Park classic for the evening.
points: Check the official offers page before you book

sections.h2: Walt Disney Studios is now Disney Adventure World
sections.html: The resort’s second park was renamed Disney Adventure World as part of a major expansion. World of Frozen, with Arendelle and its attractions, opened on 29 March 2026. A further land themed on The Lion King has been announced for a later date.

sections.h2: How many days do you need?
sections.html: Two days lets you do both parks without rushing. Three days suits families with young children who need slower days, or who want to see the parades and night-time shows.

• Under-3s go free.
  • Check official offers: Disneyland Paris runs seasonal deals on hotels and tickets on its own website.
  • Avoid peak dates like school holidays and Halloween and Christmas weekends.
  • Compare packages: some UK operators include extras like free child places. Compare family holidays on TravelDeals.

More in our Disney deals guide.

sections.h2: Before you travel from the UK
sections.html: UK travellers now go through the EU’s Entry/Exit System at the border. Read EES and ETIAS explained on TravelDeals.

faqs.q: When did World of Frozen open at Disneyland Paris?
faqs.a: World of Frozen opened on 29 March 2026, alongside the renaming of Walt Disney Studios Park to Disney Adventure World.

faqs.q: Do toddlers need a ticket for Disneyland Paris?
faqs.a: No. Children under 3 go free at Disneyland Paris.
